experiences.name: Mercado de Medellín Food Tour
experiences.description: Explore one of Mexico City's most vibrant local markets, just minutes from Doctores. Sample fresh tacos, tlayudas, tamales, and tropical fruits while chatting with local vendors. A true immersion into everyday chilango food culture.

experiences.name: Tacos de Canasta in Tepito & La Merced
experiences.description: Join a guided street food walk through the historic La Merced market area, sampling iconic tacos de canasta, quesadillas de comal, and aguas frescas. Experience the raw, authentic street food scene beloved by locals.
experiences.location: La Merced, Historic Center, Mexico City

experiences.name: Museo Nacional de Arte (MUNAL) Visit
experiences.description: Discover centuries of Mexican art from colonial paintings to 20th-century masterpieces at this stunning neoclassical palace. The museum offers deep insight into Mexico's cultural identity and artistic evolution, with very affordable entry.

experiences.name: Barrio Chino & Doctores Street Art Walk
experiences.description: Stroll through Mexico City's Chinatown and the neighboring Doctores barrio to discover vibrant murals, local cantinas, and working-class neighborhood life. Stop at a traditional pulquería to try pulque, an ancient fermented agave drink.

experiences.name: Lucha Libre Night at Arena México
experiences.description: Experience the electrifying spectacle of Mexican wrestling at Arena México, the world's most famous lucha libre venue, located just blocks from Doctores. Cheer for masked heroes and villains in a raucous, colorful atmosphere that is quintessentially Mexican.
